text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report presents the results of Transportation Services' traffic study conducted at the intersection of Thurodale Avenue and Duckworth Street to determine the feasibility for all-way stop control. The study results indicate the City's warrant for the installation of all-way stop control is not met and is not recommended at this intersection.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Did NOT authorize all-way stop control at the intersection of Thurodale Avenue and Duckworth Street.
